"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import hmac


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Build a signed, HTTP-only cookie descriptor carrying login state."""
    value = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(user_id.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), value.encode("ascii"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    cookie_value = f"{value}.{signature}"

    return {
        "name": "session",
        "value": cookie_value,
        "http_only": True,
        "secure": True,
        "same_site": "Lax",
        "path": "/",
    }
